audit.whatIsWrong: Page rated the lane EVEN 4/10 and gave Lucian six of seven level rows, but the Emerald+ figure is 34.78% over 23 games and the packet level chart reads Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox.
audit.why: Difficulty and the chart contradicted both the win rate and the page's own whys text (whys[3] already said the trades even out, whys[4]/[5] already said Aatrox wins).
audit.corrected: diff HARD, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 7/10, and rows 4-5 flipped to Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox in both layers as a matched pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first-item rows were written as Lucian kill windows.
audit.why: World Ender (120/100/80s) grants AD, move speed and increased healing; Aatrox's first-item drain plus Q at 6s rank 5 out-stats a marksman frame in any extended trade.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item now read as Aatrox spikes; Lucian's spike window is stated as levels 1-3 plus tempo conversion.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-sequencing anywhere (packet defect), and the anti-heal and auto-reset interactions were absent.
audit.why: Lucian's Q is 500 range through a target and procs Lightslinger; E is 16s at rank 1 and its cooldown is reduced by Lightslinger hits. Aatrox's Q chain is 14s at rank 1, and Deathbringer Stance is an auto-attack reset that heals off target max health.
audit.corrected: Added real numbers (Q 14s chain, E 16s refunded by Lightslinger, R 120s), the Deathbringer auto-reset wind-up tell, and Grievous Wounds timing before extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zero sequencing cues in the packet.
audit.why: Aatrox's punishable window is the Q chain (14s at rank 1) and World Ender's 120s.
audit.corrected: Trade on Q-chain downtime; do not duel into World Ender.

audit.why: Aatrox's Infernal Chains carries a derived grounding flag Riot's description does not support (drag and slow only) — mirror slice reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim made in either direction.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online (16s, cut by Lightslinger hits) — spell, double-shot, dash out before his Q chain lands.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track World Ender — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: His Q ranks to 8s and Deathbringer heals off your max HP — trade only on Q-chain downtime, never into a full three-swing.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: World Ender amps his healing, so The Culling chip just refills him — don't duel into a 120s ult, farm it out.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first-item drain plus a 6-second Q chain out-stats your frame — the kill window closed, so take plates and roam instead.

edits.before: His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Q pierces through the target and procs Lightslinger — chip him at 500 range while his 14s Q chain is down.

edits.before: That is Aatrox’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Deathbringer's auto reset is the tell — step out on the wind-up, not on his cast.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Aatrox carry threat 5/10.
edits.after: Losing matchup — difficulty 7/10, Aatrox carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Aatrox carry threat 5/10.
edits.after: Losing matchup — difficulty 7/10, Aatrox carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: His R: World Ender gives Aatrox combat stats and heal amp — once he ults your kite damage just feeds his passive heal and he runs you down.
edits.after: His R: World Ender (120s at rank 1) gives AD, speed and heal amp — your kite damage feeds Deathbringer's heal, so buy Grievous Wounds before you contest it.

notes: Level chart rows 4-6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to agree with the 34.78% win rate, the packet chart and the page's own whys text. No grounding claim made for Infernal Chains: the derived flag contradicts Riot's description (drag + slow only), matching the mirror slice. Anti-heal and auto-reset-tell interactions from _missing are now on the page.
